verdicts.title: Some permutation polynomials via linear translators
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Permutation polynomials with explicit constructions over finite fields have long been a topic of great interest in number theory. In recent years, by applying linear translators of functions from $\mathbb{F}_{q^n}$ to $\mathbb{F}_q$, many scholars constructed some classes of permutation polynomials. Motivated by previous works, we first naturally extend the notion of linear translators and then construct some permutation polynomials.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract focuses on constructing permutation polynomials over finite fields using linear translators, with no mention of Specht modules, ABP complexity, or Young diagrams. It shares only the 'permutation polynomial' vocabulary without addressing the conjecture's complexity-theoretic claim.

verdicts.title: Five Constructions of Permutation Polynomials over $\gf(q^2)$
